name: reverse-qa
description: Reverse-engineer an undocumented app: architecture, security, roles, workflows, requirements, test cases and a complete automation framework, with every claim cited to a file and line in the app's source.

xray_base_url.title: Xray API base URL
xray_base_url.description: Xray Cloud REST v2 base URL. Change it only for a regional Xray endpoint.

xray_project_key.title: Jira project key for tests
xray_project_key.description: The Jira project that receives the Xray tests, for example QA. Leave empty to work offline.

xray_client_id.title: Xray client ID
xray_client_id.description: Xray Cloud API key client ID (Xray > Settings > API Keys). Leave empty to work offline: validate and dry runs only.

xray_client_secret.title: Xray client secret
xray_client_secret.description: Xray Cloud API key client secret. Stored in the system credential store, never in settings files.
